install.headline: Install {{appName}} on your phone
install.sheetDescription: Add a home-screen icon for full-screen, app-like access.
install.safariOnly: On iOS, only Safari supports adding apps to the home screen. Open this page in Safari, then follow the steps below.
install.iosStep1: Tap the <icon/> Share button in Safari's toolbar.
install.iosStep2: Scroll the share sheet and tap Add to Home Screen.
install.iosStep3: Confirm with Add. {{appName}} now opens from the home screen like a native app.
install.androidStep1: Tap the ⋮ menu in your browser's top-right corner.
install.androidStep2: Choose Install app (Chrome) or Add to Home screen (Firefox / Samsung Internet).
install.androidStep3: Confirm. {{appName}} launches from your app drawer like any other installed app.
